comment: Data for the deterministic prose measure (council/lib/prose.py), owner ruling AC6 and spec sections U6.2/U6.3 with the number-style rules of the report design audit section C2. Thresholds, banned patterns, source cues, month names and sentence-splitter abbreviations live here as data so the council's voice is carried by its briefs and this file, never by a host machine's own instructions.

banned_patterns.message: money written as a reporting unit: convert it to $K/$M/$B, never 'N thousand dollars'
the word for a percentage: use the % sign, one decimal, never the word 'percent'
a machine date: write it in words, day first (30 Jun 2026), never 2026-06-30
